_about: Competitor evaluation-metric scorers for the CTT snapshot. Each scorer: importable `Scorer` class (Scorer(device).score(gen, ref=None, input_frame=None) -> dict) plus a CLI. `gen`/`ref` accept an .mp4 path OR a uint8 [T,H,W,3] frame array; `input_frame` accepts a PNG/JPG path OR a uint8 [H,W,3] array. Videos are decoded via diffusion.transition_eval.video_io.load_frames at short_side=256 (common.DECODE_SHORT_SIDE). Set PYTHONPATH so `diffusion` is importable OR rely on common.py which inserts <repo>/src. Run from this directory so sibling imports (common, clip_sim) resolve. env: HF_HOME=$LAB/cache/huggingface, TORCH_HOME=$LAB/cache/torch, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 (all weights pre-warmed).

_env.platform: DeltaAI GH200 / aarch64; validated on gh-login02 (CPU) + ghx4 GPU
_env.caveat_framecount: motion_smoothness and dynamic_degree are frame-count/fps-sensitive; videoprism/clip/dynamic_degree magnitudes also resolution-sensitive. Do NOT compare across clips of different frame counts (e.g. our 121f@24 vs refVFX 49f@~9.7) without disclosure -- same caveat class as core_degenerate/copy_max.

implementation.impl_sha_algo: sha256 (first 16 hex) over the sorted concatenation of impl_files bytes
implementation.note: Every batch row embeds this impl_sha; compare it across scoring batches to assert an identical implementation. Editing ANY impl_file changes the sha. run_fixtures.py is deliberately NOT in impl_files (it is fixture-only, not the scoring path).
implementation.impl_sha_change_2026-09-18: d63935f4 -> 8a808635 (feature-store P3b): score_batch.py gains --store (default on) — the per-VIDEO lens arrays (clip_b32@r256, videoprism@f16r288, raft_mag@r256, cotracker3@g20-m384-v2) are read from / written to the contract-v2 feature store BY VIDEO PATH, filled on a miss by diffusion.feature_extractors.REGISTRY (single preprocessing source); the input FRAME is embedded fresh (reusing the same REGISTRY models); .track_cache retired. Metric arithmetic (clip_sim, motion_smoothness, videoprism_sim, det_motion_fidelity, dynamic_degree) is UNCHANGED — only score_batch.py bytes changed. The paper's committed rows_v3 were produced under impl_sha d63935f4 and KEEP that sha; the 20-row numeric reproduction of rows_v3 to 1e-6 through the store needs GPU features and is P4. --no-store restores the exact legacy in-process embedder path (byte-identical arithmetic).

batch_driver.cli: python score_batch.py --glob '<gens/*.mp4>' --out-dir DIR   [--manifest FILE] [--shard N --num-shards M] [--limit K] [--overwrite]
batch_driver.inputs: --glob of gen .mp4s and/or --manifest (one path per line, or .jsonl {gen:...}). Derives reference + input frame from each filename.

derivation.ref_class: eval_ladder/prompts.clip_class(reference)  [authoritative split_v1.2.json; NOT a naive rsplit]

batch_driver.output: one JSON row per gen at <out-dir>/<item_id>.json; keys = derivation meta + all 10 metric outputs + impl_sha + warnings[] + host + elapsed_sec. NaN (e.g. det_motion_fidelity with no moving tracklets) serialized as null.
batch_driver.sharding: gens sorted+deduped, sliced [shard::num_shards]; shard/num_shards default to SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID / SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_COUNT. Per-gen skip-if-exists.
batch_driver.efficiency: loads CLIP/VideoPrism/RAFT/CoTracker ONCE; CLIP and VideoPrism gen embeddings computed once and reused across their two metrics; CoTracker tracks disk-cached by absolute path (.track_cache/) so the ~36 reference clips are tracked once and reused across all gens and shards.
batch_driver.env: source $LAB/envs-aarch64/activate; HF_HOME=$LAB/cache/huggingface; TORCH_HOME=$LAB/cache/torch; HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1. Run from this directory.

fixture_validation.gpu_job: 2941983 (ghx4, GH200 gh102), fixtures.json, 76.7s over 4 real (gen,ref) pairs incl. 1 refVFX competitor gen

direction_summary.clip_sim_ref: PASS 3/4 (weak; p4 refVFX gen inverts 0.545<0.676) -- narrow-cone ref weakness
direction_summary.videoprism_sim_ref: PASS 3/4 (thin margins ~0.001-0.017; p4 inverts) -- saturates ~0.95 narrow cone; use _input/_global for ranking
direction_summary.dynamic_degree_mean_mag: PASS 4/4 (gen 0.21-0.96 px vs static ~0.01 px). NB dynamic_degree_bit==0 for all: threshold 1.0px too high at short_side=256/consecutive-frame flow -- RAW mag is the metric; recalibrate/ignore the bit
direction_summary.det_motion_fidelity: PASS 3/4 per-pair + aggregate (mean matched 0.177 > mean mismatched 0.109); p3 earth inverts -- inherently noisy unpaired-motion metric; NaN when a clip has no moving tracklets

fixture_validation.disclose: Reference-fidelity embedding sims (clip_sim_ref, videoprism_sim_ref) discriminate the true reference only weakly; VideoPrism saturates in a narrow cone. This is a faithful refVFX/VAP-style implementation and a genuine finding about these metrics, not a bug. The *_input and *_global columns separate cleanly.

outputs.det_motion_fidelity: scalar in [-1,1]; NaN is VALID (a clip has no moving tracklets)

det_motion_fidelity.provenance: DeT / MTBench 'Motion Fidelity' (Yatim et al., Space-Time Diffusion Features): CoTracker trajectories, velocity-direction cross-correlation.
det_motion_fidelity.substrate: Wraps certified diffusion.transition_eval.motion (Tracker=CoTracker3 offline via torch.hub, motion_fidelity=pure numpy). CoTracker3 weights: cache/torch/hub/checkpoints/scaled_offline.pth + repo clone cache/torch/hub/facebookresearch_co-tracker_main.

outputs.videoprism_sim_ref: per-frame mean-of-max cosine, gen vs reference (SPEC metric)
outputs.videoprism_sim_input: per-frame mean-of-max cosine, gen vs input start frame
outputs.videoprism_sim_ref_global: BONUS: video-level cosine (L2-normalized mean of per-frame embeddings) gen vs ref
outputs.videoprism_sim_input_global: BONUS: video-level cosine gen vs input

videoprism_sim.provenance: refVFX HEADLINE automatic metric (VideoPrism embedding similarity, output-vs-reference AND output-vs-input).

model.provenance_note: COMMUNITY torch conversion of flax-only official google/videoprism-base-f16r288 (the google repo ships only flax .npz; transformers has NO conversion script, so from_pretrained cannot consume it). MHRDYN7 loads into VideoPrismVisionModel with ZERO missing/unexpected/mismatched keys (verified 2026-08-13).
model.preprocessing: shipped video_preprocessor_config.json: RGB, rescale 1/255, resize 288x288, do_normalize=FALSE, 16 frames. torchvision<0.27 falls back LANCZOS->BICUBIC (benign).
model.embedding: last_hidden_state [1,16*256,768] reshaped to [16,256,768], mean-pool 256 spatial -> 16 per-frame embeddings, L2-normalized.

videoprism_sim.caveat: VideoPrism embeddings occupy a narrow cone: absolute sims saturate ~0.95 and matched-vs-mismatched-ref margins are thin. out-vs-input separates well; ref separation is weak. Consider the _global variant for ranking. Faithful refVFX-style implementation; not a defect.

outputs.clip_sim_ref: per-frame mean-of-max cosine of CLIP embeddings, gen vs reference
outputs.clip_sim_input: per-frame mean-of-max cosine, gen vs input start frame

clip_sim.provenance: VAP 'CLIP Score' (output-vs-reference CLIP similarity); generic VBench/T2V appearance metric.

model.mirror_note: $LAB/cache/clip_vitb32_merged is a BROKEN symlink into /projects (Campus-Cluster only) -- unusable on DeltaAI; use the canonical hub id.

clip_sim.reused_by: motion_smoothness.py imports ClipEmbedder from here (load CLIP once, share).

outputs.motion_smoothness: mean cosine of consecutive-frame CLIP embeddings within gen (single video)

motion_smoothness.provenance: VBench motion-smoothness family; reported by refVFX and VAP. This is the CLIP-drift flavor (refVFX-style), NOT VBench's AMT-interpolation flavor (which needs the AMT checkpoint).

model.note: same CLIP as clip_sim; pass embedder=clip.emb to share the load.

outputs.dynamic_degree_mean_mag: mean per-frame RAFT flow magnitude (pixels at decode res) -- PRIMARY continuous value
outputs.dynamic_degree_bit: 0/1 thresholded at MOTION_THRESHOLD=1.0 px (nominal; report raw for comparisons)

dynamic_degree.provenance: VBench 'dynamic degree'; reported by refVFX, VFXMaster, Omni-Effects, VFX-Creator, VAP.

model.note: Lean inline reimplementation of diffusion.signals.flow.RAFTExtractor (avoids importing diffusion.signals whose __init__ eagerly loads SAM/YOLO). Frames forced to dims divisible by 8 (RAFT requirement), longest side capped at 1024.

dynamic_degree.caveat: magnitude is resolution- AND frame-count/fps-sensitive; not comparable across differing frame counts without disclosure.
